context.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
context.same_seed_only: A/A across clock arms: no transform changed, so no new float64 model reference is needed. A clock change must not move the structure; if it does, that is a finding and a STOP.
context.conventions: the 512 bar and its 1.84 A user seed floor and the 298 bar with its own 0.741-0.847 A archived upstream seed pairs are each used only at their own size

refutation_criteria: fitted F at or below 0 s: there is no clock-immune term and the two-parameter inverse-clock form is wrong
fitted F at or above the 298 aa fold time at 1350 MHz (9.680 s): a fixed cost larger than the whole smaller fold is not credible as a fixed cost
cell-median residual at an intermediate clock larger than max(A/A timing floor, 0.05 s): the fold is not T = F + C/f and F is not identified by this fit
any arm whose during-fold clock is not exactly its own requested target
model_check.note: refuting the exact 1/f form is a FINDING about the fold, not a failed capture: the arms held, the host was quiet and the structure never moved. Only an F at or below 0 s, or at or above the fastest fold, would make F meaningless.
